name: FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 (and other FIBA events)
country: Global; 2027 World Cup hosted by Qatar
notes: World Cup runs 27 Aug - 12 Sep 2027 in Qatar, the first edition hosted in the Arab world (FIBA event page and FIBA event news, fetched 25 Sep 2026). Qualifiers run Nov 2025 - Mar 2027 across four regions.

Only two of the 32 World Cup teams are confirmed as of 25 Sep 2026: Qatar (qualified automatically as host) and Tuerkiye (first to qualify, FIBA news 'Turkiye qualify for World Cup', published 2026-08-31). The field is not set until qualifiers end in early 2027; the team list must be extended then.

Sponsorship story is event-level: national teams do not carry jersey sponsors, so the record is FIBA's own partner roster (10 FIBA Partners, 4 Global Suppliers) as league-partner deals, plus the Qatari state as event host (recorded in unsourced: event-host shape).

FIBA's partners page and the World Cup 2027 event page list slightly different rosters: Jetour is a Global Supplier on the partners page but appears in the FIBA Partners footer of the event page; the event news calls Jetour FIBA's 'Official Car Supplier'.
Venues per FIBA event news: Lusail Arena (final), Duhail Arena, Ali Bin Hamad Al Attiyah Arena and Al Janoub Arena (a 2022 FIFA World Cup stadium converted for basketball).
Host award: FIBA announced Qatar as 2027 host at its Central Board meeting in Metro Manila on 28 Apr 2023, by unanimous vote (Wikipedia lead; FIBA primary release not located).
